parameters.query: =WITH assets AS (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'source_type',source_type,'drive_file_id',drive_file_id,'file_name',file_name,'mime_type',mime_type,'parse_status',parse_status,'metadata',extracted_metadata)) AS asset_index FROM content_assets WHERE job_id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid), output_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_outputs (job_id,output_type,title,structured_data,qa_status) SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,'asset_index','Asset Index',COALESCE(asset_index,'[]'::jsonb),'pending' FROM assets RETURNING id), event_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata) SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,'asset_index_created','Asset index created',jsonb_build_object('output_id',(SELECT id FROM output_insert))) SELECT (SELECT id::text FROM output_insert) AS output_id;
